experiments.title: Compare molecules
experiments.instruction: Predict first. Start each trial at outside 12 and inside 4. Keep equal compartment size, cell type, carrier off and one model step fixed; change only the molecule from oxygen to glucose.
experiments.observe: Oxygen changes from 12.0/4.0 to 11.0/5.0, while glucose stays at 12.0/4.0 without its carrier. Explain why a concentration difference drives net movement only when the membrane provides a path.

experiments.title: Add a carrier
experiments.instruction: Predict first. Use glucose at outside 12 and inside 4 in both trials. Keep equal compartment size and one model step fixed; change only whether the specific glucose carrier is present.
experiments.observe: Without the carrier glucose stays at 12.0/4.0; with it glucose changes to 11.0/5.0 while the total stays 16.0 relative units. Explain why a selective path enables facilitated diffusion but does not create or pump glucose.
